title: Game Map Viewer — game.json
description: Contract for a single game's map configuration, produced by nes_decoder and consumed by the map_viewer web app. See CONTRACT.md.

id.description: Stable game identifier. Must match the registry entry and the res/{id}/ folder name.

defaultMap.description: Key in `maps` shown first and treated as the navigation root (usually "world_map").

localizedString.description: Display text keyed by language code. At least one entry required; `en` is the fallback.

type.description: Render mode. Only "image" is currently implemented by the viewer.

image.description: Path to the map image, relative to this game.json's folder (res/{id}/).

thumbnail.description: Optional low-res placeholder for progressive loading. Only used when `width` and `height` are also present.

width.description: Optional intrinsic pixel width of `image`. Lets the viewer skip probing the full image.

tileSize.description: Tile size in pixels; drives the grid overlay and the editor's snap-to-grid. Typically 16.

tilesPath.description: Tile URL template (reserved for future type=tiles).

pois.description: Points of interest (treasure chests, etc.) shown as icons.

events.description: Event-driven tile changes (e.g. a wall opening); each is a toggleable overlay.

event.description: A terrain change a map applies when a story event fires; toggled by a checkbox in the viewer.

overlay.description: Path to the changed-tiles overlay image, relative to this game.json's folder.

tiles.description: Number of tiles this event changes.

trigger.description: A clickable zone that navigates to another map (a door / exit / warp).

target.description: Key of the destination map within this same game's `maps`. Must reference an existing map (referential integrity is not expressible in JSON Schema — validate separately).

poi.description: A point of interest on a map (e.g. a treasure chest).

pos.description: Pixel position [x, y] (top-left of the tile), full-resolution image space.

item.description: Optional item id/hex for treasure POIs.

bounds.description: Axis-aligned rectangle in FULL-RESOLUTION image pixels: [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]], top-left origin.
